subject: math
mcq_rule_ar: أ) يتكون هذا الفرع من (٣) فقرات من نوع اختيار من متعدد، من أربعة بدائل، انقل البديل الصحيح إلى دفتر الإجابة: (٦ علامات)
mcq_rule_en: Part (a) of every question: 3 four-option MCQ items worth 6 marks together (2 each, inferred).
scope_note: Paper 1 covers units 1-2 (differentiation and its applications).

choice_rules.rule_ar: عدد أسئلة الورقة (ستة) أسئلة، أجب عن (خمسة) منها فقط

sections.rule_ar: القسم الأول: يتكون هذا القسم من (أربعة) أسئلة، وعلى المشترك أن يجيب عنها جميعاً.
القسم الثاني: يتكون هذا القسم من (سؤالين)، وعلى المشترك أن يجيب عن سؤال واحد فقط.

items.answer_source: assets/js/solutions.js (existing verified Najih solution), re-checked by the tagger
items.note: Interval re-read from the scan at 300 dpi: printed ]0, pi/3], open at 0 and closed at pi/3. The bracket beside pi/3 encloses it (same orientation as the closed [0,3] in Q2-a-2 on the same page); the bracket beside 0 faces away from it (same orientation as both brackets of the open ]0, pi/4[ in s2-p1 Q4-a-3). f'(x)=sin x(2cos x-1) > 0 on ]0, pi/3[, so f increases up to the included endpoint and f(pi/3)=5/4 is a local (and absolute) maximum by the book's endpoint test (lesson 2-3 allows endpoints of the domain to be local extrema). x=0 is excluded from the domain, so it is not a critical number here.

items.note: The argument of the sine is printed as pi over "4x" (read as pi/(4x)); with that reading the third factor contributes nothing at x=1/2 and f'(1/2)=-pi.

discrepancies.issue: Printed "isosceles" (متساوي الساقين) but asks for the side length; equilateral intended.

summary.note_marks_by_lesson: Marks of every printed item split equally across its lessons; sums to the printed marks of all six questions (not the score a candidate can reach under the choice rule).

notes: Matrices and determinants in "latex" follow the paper's right-to-left (Arabic) reading: the right-most printed column is column 1 and rows read from right to left, so a matrix printed left to right as [3, -2 / -5, x] is transcribed [[-2,3],[x,-5]]. This reading is confirmed wherever an answer depends on it: 2025 s2-p2 Q2-a-1 gives the listed x=4 only under it (left to right gives x=8/3, not an option); likewise s2-p2 Q3-a-1 (-4) and s3 Q4-a-1 (A^-1). Anyone re-checking a transcription against the scan must mirror each row.

Part (a) MCQ items carry no printed per-item marks; each is inferred as part-marks / 3. Numbered sub-parts of (b)/(c) carry no printed marks; they are inferred as an equal split of the printed part marks (marks_basis says so).
A lone dot used as an integral limit is the Arabic-Indic digit zero (٠).
No item tests unit 6 (complex numbers) in any 2025 paper.
Section 1 now has four compulsory questions (Q1-Q4) and section 2 two questions (answer one), unlike 2024 (3 + choose 2 of 3).
